inputs: p_session uuid (actual authenticated session checked by trusted adapter and auth.uid())
p_org uuid (pinned selected same live org)
p_request uuid (caller retains per actor membership/org)

outcomes.retired: original new result before verified COMMIT
outcomes.replayed: original committed metadata under fresh admission and original intent, no writes
outcomes.conflict: existing actor/request key has different operation, target or expected revisions
outcomes.stale: new otherwise admissible request has stale role or authority revision
outcomes.in_use: new current request found an assignment reference regardless of status
outcomes.unavailable: scope/control/session/role/receipt/ceiling failure; anomalous reference on exact historical replay unavailable
outcomes.exception: lock or post-write validation failure; transaction must roll back, no response treated as success

contract.ceiling: private original template keys subset of current effective keys; no target-base ceiling
contract.ceilingEvidence: 17-bit mask of actual DB role keys, zero-based order from frozen supported catalog, stored only in private receipt, with digest and validated against intent
contract.executeUnder: READ COMMITTED inside canonical trusted adapter; currently no runtime caller privileges
contract.mutation: draft|active -> retired; no membership/assignment writes; exactly one role and one org epoch increment, one command and one audit
contract.replayOrder: Fresh management checks; original command/target/expected checks; reconstruct original ceiling and digest, no current target revision requirement. Recheck no reference/fresh session/authority before returning original result.
contract.newOutcomePrecedence: Failed governance/ceiling or missing/retired target -> unavailable. Current expected revisions required before in_use; all rejection results carry NULL identities/revisions.
